comparison.objective: Inspect a suitcase pull handle at four lock heights and tag defective units.
comparison.physical_skill: Bracing, telescoping-handle actuation, load testing, state-dependent tagging, and closure.
comparison.success_condition: All heights checked or worn lock made to give, correct tag verdict, handle closed, case restored, arms returned for 1 s.
comparison.reason: Tests active mechanical inspection and conditional disposition, not separation by aperture size.
